versions.shortDescription: Graph-based clustering using scikit-learn SpectralClustering (eigenvectors + k-means).
versions.longDescription: This tool runs SpectralClustering from scikit-learn. It constructs an affinity matrix (e.g., RBF or a k-NN graph), computes a spectral embedding (eigenvectors of the graph Laplacian), and then clusters in the embedding space (typically via k-means). Outputs: cluster labels per sample, optionally the spectral embedding, and an HTML report with parameters and statistics.

hyperparams.name: affinity
hyperparams.description: Affinity definition: rbf, nearest_neighbors, precomputed (if the input is already an affinity matrix).

hyperparams.name: gamma
hyperparams.description: Gamma for the RBF kernel (only if affinity='rbf').

hyperparams.name: n_neighbors
hyperparams.description: Number of neighbors for the k-NN graph (only if affinity='nearest_neighbors').

hyperparams.name: assign_labels
hyperparams.description: Clustering in the embedding space: kmeans or discretize.

hyperparams.name: n_init
hyperparams.description: Number of k-means initializations (relevant when assign_labels='kmeans').

hyperparams.name: eigen_solver
hyperparams.description: Eigen solver: arpack, lobpcg, amg (amg requires pyamg).

hyperparams.name: random_state
hyperparams.description: Seed for reproducibility (especially for k-means / discretize).

hyperparams.name: standardize
hyperparams.description: Standardizes features (zero mean / unit variance) before clustering (recommended).

input.name: features
input.description: Tabular feature matrix (or affinity matrix when affinity='precomputed'). If features: rows=samples, columns=numeric features. Optional first column 'id'.

output.name: labels
output.description: Cluster assignment per sample. Columns: [id?/index, label].

output.name: embedding
output.description: Spectral embedding (eigenvectors). Rows=samples, columns=components (typically n_clusters). (Only if output_embedding=true).

output.name: report
output.description: HTML report with parameters, affinity settings, eigen solver, and cluster size statistics.
